records.literal_gloss: And said to them the Jesus, The sons of the age this marry and are given in marriage, \v 35 but the [ones] having been counted worthy that age to obtain and of the resurrection the [one] from dead neither marry nor are given in marriage;

en.L: And Jesus said to them, "The {{gender:children|sons}} of this age marry and are given in marriage, \v 35 but those who are counted worthy to attain to that age and to the resurrection from [the] dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.
en.B: Jesus answered them, "In this age, men take wives and women are given to husbands. \v 35 But those who are judged worthy to have a share in the age to come and in the rising from the dead neither take wives nor are given to husbands.
en.R: Jesus said to them, "In this life, people get married. \v 35 But God will count some people worthy to live in the age that is coming. He will raise them from the dead. Those people will not get married.

es.L: Y Jesús les dijo: «Los hijos de esta era se casan y son dados en matrimonio, \v 35 pero los que son tenidos por dignos de alcanzar aquella era y la resurrección de entre [los] muertos ni se casan ni son dados en matrimonio.
es.B: Jesús les respondió: «En esta era, los hombres toman esposa y las mujeres son dadas en matrimonio. \v 35 Pero los que son juzgados dignos de tener parte en la era venidera y en la resurrección de entre los muertos, ni los hombres toman esposa ni las mujeres son dadas a un esposo.
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «En esta vida la gente se casa. \v 35 Pero Dios considerará a algunos dignos de vivir en la era que viene. Él los resucitará. Esas personas no se casarán.

fr.L: Et Jésus leur dit : « Les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de cet âge se marient et sont donnés en mariage, \v 35 mais ceux qui ont été jugés dignes d’avoir part à cet âge-là et à la résurrection d’entre les morts ne se marient pas et ne sont pas donnés en mariage.
fr.B: Jésus leur répondit : « Dans le monde présent, les hommes prennent femme et les femmes sont données à un mari. \v 35 Mais ceux qui sont jugés dignes d’avoir part au monde à venir et à la résurrection d’entre les morts ne prennent plus de femme, et les femmes n’y sont plus données à un mari.
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Dans cette vie, les gens se marient. \v 35 Mais Dieu jugera certaines personnes dignes de vivre dans le monde qui vient. Il les fera revenir de la mort à la vie. Ces gens-là ne se marieront pas.

sw.L: Naye Yesu akawaambia, "Wana wa zama hizi huoa na huozwa, \v 35 lakini wale wanaohesabiwa kuwa wamestahili kuzipata zama zile na ufufuo kutoka kwa wafu hawaoi wala hawaozwi.
sw.B: Yesu akawajibu, "Katika zama hizi, wanaume huoa na wanawake huozwa kwa waume. \v 35 Lakini wale wanaohesabiwa kuwa wanastahili kushiriki zama zijazo na ufufuo kutoka kwa wafu, hawaoi wala hawaozwi.
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Katika maisha haya watu huoa na kuolewa. \v 35 Lakini Mungu atawahesabu watu fulani kuwa wanastahili kuishi katika ulimwengu ujao. Atawafufua kutoka kwa wafu. Watu hao hawataoa wala kuolewa.

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Con cái của đời này cưới và được gả; \v 35 nhưng những người được kể là xứng đáng đạt đến đời ấy và sự sống lại từ [cõi] chết thì không cưới cũng không được gả.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu trả lời họ: "Ở đời này, đàn ông thì cưới vợ, đàn bà thì được gả chồng. \v 35 Nhưng những ai được xem là xứng đáng dự phần vào đời sau và sự sống lại từ cõi chết thì không cưới vợ cũng không gả chồng.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Trong đời này, người ta lấy vợ lấy chồng. \v 35 Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời sẽ xem một số người là xứng đáng được sống trong đời sắp đến. Ngài sẽ làm cho họ sống lại từ cõi chết. Những người ấy sẽ không lấy vợ lấy chồng nữa.

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "이 세대의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}은 장가도 가고 시집도 간다. \v 35 그러나 저 세대와 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아나는 부활을 얻기에 합당하다고 여겨진 사람들은 장가가지도 않고 시집가지도 않는다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "이 세상에서는 남자는 장가가고 여자는 시집간다. \v 35 그러나 오는 세상과 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아나는 부활에 참여할 자격이 있다고 인정받은 사람들은 장가가지도 않고 시집가지도 않는다.
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "이 세상에서는 사람들이 결혼을 한다. \v 35 그러나 하나님께서는 어떤 사람들을 오는 세상에서 살 자격이 있다고 여기신다. 하나님께서 그들을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 다시 살리실 것이다. 그런 사람들은 결혼하지 않는다.

pt.L: E Jesus lhes disse: "Os filhos desta era se casam e são dados em casamento, \v 35 mas os que são considerados dignos de alcançar aquela era e a ressurreição dentre [os] mortos nem se casam nem são dados em casamento.
pt.B: Jesus lhes respondeu: "Nesta era, os homens tomam esposas e as mulheres são dadas em casamento. \v 35 Mas os que forem julgados dignos de participar da era que virá e da ressurreição dos mortos não se casam nem são dados em casamento.
pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: "Nesta vida, as pessoas se casam. \v 35 Mas Deus vai considerar algumas pessoas dignas de viver na era que está chegando. Ele vai ressuscitá-las dos mortos. Essas pessoas não vão se casar.

am.L: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «የዚህ ዘመን ልጆች ያገባሉ፤ ይዳራሉም፤ \v 35 ያንን ዘመንና ከሙታን የሆነውን ትንሣኤ ለማግኘት የተገባቸው ሆነው የተቆጠሩት ግን አያገቡም፤ አይዳሩምም።
am.B: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰላቸው፦ «በዚህ ዘመን ወንዶች ሚስት ያገባሉ፤ ሴቶችም ለባል ይዳራሉ። \v 35 በሚመጣው ዘመንና ከሙታን በመነሣት ድርሻ እንዲኖራቸው የተገባቸው ሆነው የተቆጠሩት ግን ወንዶቹ ሚስት አያገቡም፤ ሴቶቹም ለባል አይዳሩም።
am.R: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «በዚህ ሕይወት ሰዎች ያገባሉ። \v 35 እግዚአብሔር ግን አንዳንድ ሰዎችን በሚመጣው ዘመን ለመኖር የተገባቸው አድርጎ ይቆጥራቸዋል። ከሙታንም ያስነሣቸዋል። እነዚህ ሰዎች አያገቡም።

decisions.choice: the sons of this age: the people of this present life
decisions.reason: "Sons of" means those who belong to something, as in 16:8. Here it simply means people living in this age, before the resurrection.

decisions.choice: marry and are given in marriage: men take wives, and women are given by their families
decisions.reason: A man married; a woman was given in marriage by her father (17:27). Together the verbs cover all marrying.

decisions.choice: counted worthy: by God
decisions.reason: The passive verb means that God judges them worthy, as Jews often spoke of God's acts without naming him (21:36).

decisions.choice: that age and the resurrection from the dead: the life of the age to come, entered by being raised
alternatives: life in heaven right after death
decisions.reason: Jews spoke of this age and the age to come (18:30). Jesus speaks of the resurrection of those who belong to God, "the resurrection of the righteous" (14:14).

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: The phrase means people of both sexes, as in 16:8.

decisions.choice: In this age, men take wives and women are given to husbands (B); In this life, people get married (R)
alternatives: The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the idiom's meaning (m1) and shows the two verbs (m2); Readable says it in the simplest way.

decisions.choice: God will count some people worthy; He will raise them from the dead
alternatives: those counted worthy ... and the resurrection from the dead
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who judges them worthy (m3) and makes the resurrection a separate sentence.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 20:38
decisions.reason: Jesus' answer runs over several sentences.

decisions.choice: hijos, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English sets "children" against "sons". Spanish "hijos" in the plural already includes daughters, as "hermanos" includes sisters, so there is no second wording for the setting to choose. The same in verse 36.

decisions.choice: esta era; aquella era (L); la era venidera (B); la era que viene (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is an age: this present life and the life of the age to come (meaning decisions m1, m4). "Siglo" is the older rendering but today means a century; "mundo" would lose the contrast of two ages.

decisions.choice: cet âge, cet âge-là (L); le monde présent, le monde à venir (B); cette vie, le monde qui vient (R)
decisions.reason: The word means an age of the world, this present life and the life to come (m1, m4). Literal keeps "âge", as the English "age"; "siècle" in this sense is old church language and now means a hundred years. Balanced and Readable use the usual French phrases for the two ages.

decisions.choice: zama hizi; zama zile (L); zama zijazo (B); ulimwengu ujao (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is an age: this present life and the life of the age to come (meaning decisions m1, m4). "Zama" keeps the two ages side by side; "kizazi" is a generation, and Readable says "ulimwengu ujao" (the world to come), as the shared term list has it.

decisions.choice: "Con cái của đời này" (L) with no gender span
decisions.reason: "con cái" is the Vietnamese word for children of either sex, as in Luke 6:35 and Matthew 5:9; the English gender setting has nothing to change here (also 20:36).

decisions.choice: "cưới ... được gả" (L); "cưới vợ ... gả chồng" (B)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:25: men marry and women are given in marriage (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: {{gender:자녀들|아들들}} (L), with the particle outside the span
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 6:35; Balanced and Readable say "this world" with no noun for the people.

decisions.choice: "이 세대" and "저 세대" (L), "이 세상" and "오는 세상" (B, R) for the two ages; "장가가다" and "시집가다" (L, B), "결혼하다" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Mark 12:25 for marrying; the two ages are this life and the age to come (meaning decisions).

decisions.choice: Os filhos desta era, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "children" and "sons". Portuguese "filhos" already means sons and daughters together, as in Matthew 5:9 in Portuguese, so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: "ያገባሉ ... ይዳራሉ" (they take wives ... are given in marriage)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 22:30: Amharic has the same pair as the Greek, a man "ያገባል" and a woman "ትዳራለች", so both verbs come through; Readable says simply "people marry", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "የዚህ ዘመን ልጆች" with no gender span (here and in 20:36)
decisions.reason: The English gives "children" by default for the Greek "sons". Amharic "ልጆች" already means sons and daughters, and "the children of this age" means people in general, so there is no second wording for the setting to offer.

source.text: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἀποθανεῖν ἔτι δύνανται, ἰσάγγελοι γάρ εἰσιν καὶ υἱοί εἰσιν θεοῦ τῆς ἀναστάσεως υἱοὶ ὄντες.

records.literal_gloss: neither for to die any longer are they able, equal-to-angels for they are, and sons they are of God of the resurrection sons being.

en.L: For they cannot die anymore, for they are equal to angels, and they are {{gender:children|sons}} of God, being {{gender:children|sons}} of the resurrection.
en.B: They will never die again, for they are equal to the angels; and having had their share in the resurrection, they are {{gender:children|sons}} of God.
en.R: They cannot die anymore. In this way they are like the angels. They are God's {{gender:children|sons}}, because God has raised them to new life.

es.L: Porque ya no pueden morir, pues son iguales a los ángeles, y son hijos de Dios, siendo hijos de la resurrección.
es.B: Ya no pueden volver a morir, porque son iguales a los ángeles; y, puesto que han tenido parte en la resurrección, son hijos de Dios.
es.R: Ya no pueden morir. En eso son como los ángeles. Son hijos de Dios, porque Dios los ha resucitado a una vida nueva.

fr.L: Car ils ne peuvent plus mourir, car ils sont égaux aux anges, et ils sont {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu, étant {{gender:enfants|fils}} de la résurrection.
fr.B: Ils ne mourront plus jamais, car ils sont pareils aux anges ; et, ayant part à la résurrection, ils sont {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu.
fr.R: Ils ne pourront plus mourir. Ainsi, ils seront comme les anges. Ils sont les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu, parce que Dieu les a fait revivre.

sw.L: Kwa maana hawawezi tena kufa, kwa kuwa wako sawa na malaika, nao ni wana wa Mungu, kwa kuwa ni wana wa ufufuo.
sw.B: Hawatakufa tena kamwe, kwa sababu wako sawa na malaika; na kwa kuwa wameshiriki ufufuo, wao ni watoto wa Mungu.
sw.R: Hawawezi kufa tena. Kwa njia hiyo wako kama malaika. Wao ni watoto wa Mungu, kwa sababu Mungu amewafufua kwenye uzima mpya.

vi.L: Vì họ không thể chết nữa, vì họ giống như các thiên sứ, và là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời, vì là con cái của sự sống lại.
vi.B: Họ không thể chết nữa, vì họ giống như các thiên sứ. Họ là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời, vì đã được dự phần vào sự sống lại.
vi.R: Họ không thể chết nữa. Như vậy họ giống như các thiên sứ. Họ là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời, vì Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho họ sống lại để có sự sống mới.

ko.L: 그들은 더 이상 죽을 수도 없기 때문이다. 그들은 천사들과 같고, 부활의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}이므로 하나님의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}이다.
ko.B: 그들은 다시는 죽을 수도 없다. 그들은 천사들과 같기 때문이다. 그들은 부활에 참여한 사람들이므로 하나님의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}이다.
ko.R: 그들은 더는 죽지 않는다. 그 점에서 그들은 천사들과 같다. 하나님께서 그들을 새 생명으로 다시 살리셨기 때문에, 그들은 하나님의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}이다.

pt.L: Pois já não podem morrer, porque são iguais aos anjos, e são filhos de Deus, sendo filhos da ressurreição.
pt.B: Eles nunca mais vão morrer, pois são iguais aos anjos; e, por terem participado da ressurreição, são filhos de Deus.
pt.R: Essas pessoas não podem mais morrer. Nisso elas são como os anjos. São filhos de Deus, porque Deus as ressuscitou para uma vida nova.

am.L: ከእንግዲህ ሊሞቱ አይችሉምና፤ ከመላእክት ጋር እኩል ናቸውና፤ የትንሣኤም ልጆች ሆነው የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው።
am.B: ከእንግዲህ ፈጽሞ አይሞቱም፤ ከመላእክት ጋር እኩል ናቸውና። በትንሣኤም ድርሻ ስላገኙ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው።
am.R: ከእንግዲህ ሊሞቱ አይችሉም። በዚህም እንደ መላእክት ናቸው። እግዚአብሔር ወደ አዲስ ሕይወት ስላስነሣቸው የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው።

decisions.choice: equal to angels: like the angels in not dying
decisions.reason: The word is found only here in the Bible. People raised to life share the angels' deathless life; they do not become angels. The Sadducees also denied that angels exist (Acts 23:8).

decisions.choice: for: why there is no marrying
decisions.reason: Marriage in this life carries on families in the face of death (20:28). Those who can no longer die have no need of it.

decisions.choice: sons of God, being sons of the resurrection: God's children, because they share in the resurrection
decisions.reason: "Son of" means one who belongs to or shares in something (16:8). Those raised by God are his children (6:35; Romans 8:23).

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: The phrase means men and women (m3).

decisions.choice: having had their share in the resurrection (B); because God has raised them to new life (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the second "sons of" phrase (m3).

decisions.choice: "con cái" with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in 20:34: the Vietnamese word already includes sons and daughters.

decisions.choice: {{gender:자녀들|아들들}} at every level, with the particle outside the span; "부활의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}" (L), "부활에 참여한 사람들" (B)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 6:35; Balanced and Readable explain "sons of the resurrection" as the English does.

decisions.choice: filhos de Deus, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: As in 20:34: Portuguese "filhos" already includes daughters, so the English "children/sons" setting has no Portuguese counterpart.

source.text: ὅτι δὲ ἐγείρονται οἱ νεκροὶ καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐμήνυσεν ἐπὶ τῆς βάτου, ὡς λέγει κύριον τὸν θεὸν Ἀβραὰμ καὶ θεὸν Ἰσαὰκ καὶ θεὸν Ἰακώβ·

records.literal_gloss: That but are raised the dead, even Moses showed at the bush, as he calls Lord the God of Abraham and God of Isaac and God of Jacob;

en.L: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed in [the passage about] the bush, when he calls [the] Lord 'the God of Abraham and [the] God of Isaac and [the] God of Jacob.'
en.B: And that the dead are raised, even Moses made plain in the account of the burning bush, where he calls the Lord 'the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob.'
en.R: Even Moses showed that the dead will rise. In the story of the bush that was on fire, Moses calls the Lord 'the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

es.L: Pero que los muertos son resucitados, también Moisés [lo] mostró en [el pasaje de] la zarza, cuando llama al Señor “el Dios de Abraham y [el] Dios de Isaac y [el] Dios de Jacob”.
es.B: Y que los muertos resucitan, hasta Moisés lo dejó claro en el relato de la zarza ardiente, donde llama al Señor “el Dios de Abraham, el Dios de Isaac y el Dios de Jacob”.
es.R: Hasta Moisés mostró que los muertos resucitarán. En la historia de la zarza que ardía, Moisés llama al Señor “el Dios de Abraham, el Dios de Isaac y el Dios de Jacob”.

fr.L: Mais que les morts sont relevés, Moïse aussi l’a montré au [passage du] buisson, quand il appelle le Seigneur “le Dieu d’Abraham et le Dieu d’Isaac et le Dieu de Jacob”.
fr.B: Et que les morts se relèvent, Moïse lui-même l’a fait comprendre dans le récit du buisson ardent, où il appelle le Seigneur “le Dieu d’Abraham, le Dieu d’Isaac et le Dieu de Jacob”.
fr.R: Même Moïse a montré que les morts reviendront à la vie. Dans l’histoire du buisson qui brûlait, Moïse appelle le Seigneur “le Dieu d’Abraham, le Dieu d’Isaac et le Dieu de Jacob”.

sw.L: Lakini kwamba wafu hufufuliwa, hata Musa alionyesha katika [habari ya] kichaka, anapomwita Bwana 'Mungu wa Abrahamu na Mungu wa Isaka na Mungu wa Yakobo.'
sw.B: Na kwamba wafu hufufuliwa, hata Musa alilionyesha wazi katika habari ya kichaka kilichokuwa kikiwaka moto, pale anapomwita Bwana 'Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaka na Mungu wa Yakobo.'
sw.R: Hata Musa alionyesha kwamba wafu watafufuka. Katika habari ya kichaka kilichokuwa kikiwaka moto, Musa anamwita Bwana 'Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaka, na Mungu wa Yakobo.'

vi.L: Còn việc kẻ chết được sống lại, thì chính Môi-se cũng đã cho thấy ở [đoạn nói về] bụi gai, khi ông gọi Chúa là 'Đức Chúa Trời của Áp-ra-ham, và Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sác, và Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp.'
vi.B: Còn việc người chết được sống lại, thì chính Môi-se cũng đã cho thấy rõ trong đoạn nói về bụi gai cháy, khi ông gọi Chúa là 'Đức Chúa Trời của Áp-ra-ham, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sác và Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp.'
vi.R: Ngay cả Môi-se cũng cho thấy rằng người chết sẽ sống lại. Trong câu chuyện về bụi gai đang cháy, Môi-se gọi Chúa là 'Đức Chúa Trời của Áp-ra-ham, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sác và Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp.'

ko.L: 그런데 죽은 사람들이 일으켜진다는 것은 모세도 떨기나무 [대목]에서 보여 주었다. 거기서 그는 주님을 '아브라함의 하나님, 이삭의 하나님, 야곱의 하나님'이라고 부른다.
ko.B: 죽은 사람들이 살아난다는 것은 모세도 불붙은 떨기나무 이야기에서 밝혀 주었다. 거기서 모세는 주님을 '아브라함의 하나님, 이삭의 하나님, 야곱의 하나님'이라고 부른다.
ko.R: 모세도 죽은 사람들이 다시 살아난다는 것을 보여 주었다. 불타는 떨기나무 이야기에서, 모세는 주님을 '아브라함의 하나님, 이삭의 하나님, 야곱의 하나님'이라고 부른다.

pt.L: Mas que os mortos são ressuscitados, até Moisés mostrou, [na passagem] da sarça, quando chama [o] Senhor 'o Deus de Abraão, e [o] Deus de Isaque, e [o] Deus de Jacó'.
pt.B: E que os mortos ressuscitam, até Moisés deixou claro no relato da sarça ardente, onde chama o Senhor de 'o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque e o Deus de Jacó'.
pt.R: Até Moisés mostrou que os mortos vão ressuscitar. Na história do arbusto que pegava fogo, Moisés chama o Senhor de 'o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque e o Deus de Jacó'.

am.L: ሙታን እንደሚነሡ ግን ሙሴ ራሱ በቁጥቋጦው [ክፍል] አመለከተ፤ ጌታን “የአብርሃም አምላክ፣ የይስሐቅም አምላክ፣ የያዕቆብም አምላክ” ብሎ ሲጠራው።
am.B: ሙታን እንደሚነሡ ሙሴ እንኳ በሚነደው ቁጥቋጦ ታሪክ ግልጽ አድርጓል፤ በዚያ ጌታን “የአብርሃም አምላክ፣ የይስሐቅ አምላክና የያዕቆብ አምላክ” ብሎ ይጠራዋል።
am.R: ሙሴ እንኳ ሙታን እንደሚነሡ አሳይቷል። በእሳት ይነድ ስለ ነበረው ቁጥቋጦ በሚናገረው ታሪክ ውስጥ ሙሴ ጌታን “የአብርሃም አምላክ፣ የይስሐቅ አምላክና የያዕቆብ አምላክ” ብሎ ይጠራዋል።

decisions.choice: the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob: Exodus 3:6, from the bush that burned but was not consumed
decisions.reason: At the bush God told Moses that he was the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob (Exodus 3:6, 15-16). There "Lord" stands for the divine name, YHWH. The Sadducees appealed to Moses (20:28); Jesus answers from Moses too.

decisions.choice: at the bush: in the passage about the bush
decisions.reason: Before the Scriptures had chapter numbers, a passage was named by its subject (Mark 12:26; Romans 11:2).

decisions.choice: showed: made known, pointed out
decisions.reason: The verb means to reveal or report something (John 11:57; Acts 23:30). Moses' words point to the truth Jesus draws out of them.

decisions.choice: he calls: Moses, in what he wrote
decisions.reason: In Exodus God says these words. Jesus speaks of them as what Moses says, since Moses wrote them down.

decisions.choice: the account of the burning bush (B); the story of the bush that was on fire (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that "the bush" means a passage of Scripture (m2) and which bush it was.

decisions.choice: the Lord
decisions.reason: The Greek has the ordinary word for Lord, so every level writes "Lord", and the meaning decision notes the divine name in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" with no divine-name setting; "bụi gai", "Y-sác", "Gia-cốp"
decisions.reason: The Greek has kyrios; the names and the bush as in Mark 12:26.

decisions.choice: "떨기나무"; "[대목]" (L), "이야기" (B, R); "주님" with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: As the Korean Mark 12:26. The quotation is Exodus 3:6, where the Hebrew has the divine name, but Luke's Greek has kyrios and Moses "calls" him so.

source.text: θεὸς δὲ οὐκ ἔστιν νεκρῶν ἀλλὰ ζώντων, πάντες γὰρ αὐτῷ ζῶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: God but not he is of dead but of living, all for to him live.

en.L: Now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is not God of [the] dead but of [the] living, for all live to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: God is not a God of dead people but of living people, since all of them live in relation to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: God is not the God of people who are dead. He is the God of people who are alive. All of them are alive to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: Ahora bien, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no es Dios de [los] muertos, sino de [los] vivos, porque todos viven para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».
es.B: Dios no es Dios de muertos, sino de vivos, porque todos viven en relación con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».
es.R: Dios no es el Dios de los que están muertos. Es el Dios de los que están vivos. Para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todos ellos están vivos».

fr.L: Or {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’est pas Dieu des morts, mais des vivants, car tous vivent pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »
fr.B: Dieu n’est pas un Dieu de morts, mais de vivants, puisque tous sont vivants pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »
fr.R: Dieu n’est pas le Dieu des gens qui sont morts. Il est le Dieu des gens qui sont vivants. Pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, ils sont tous vivants. »

sw.L: Basi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} si Mungu wa wafu, bali wa walio hai, kwa maana wote wanaishi kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."
sw.B: Mungu si Mungu wa watu waliokufa, bali wa walio hai, kwa kuwa wote wako hai mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."
sw.R: Mungu si Mungu wa watu waliokufa. Yeye ni Mungu wa watu walio hai. Mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} wote wako hai."

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không phải là Đức Chúa Trời của người chết, mà của người sống, vì mọi người đều sống đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời không phải là Đức Chúa Trời của người chết, nhưng của người sống, vì đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tất cả đều đang sống."
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời không phải là Đức Chúa Trời của những người đã chết. Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của những người đang sống. Đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tất cả những người ấy đều đang sống."

ko.L: 그분은 죽은 사람들의 하나님이 아니라 살아 있는 사람들의 [하나님]이시다. 모든 사람이 그분께는 살아 있기 때문이다."
ko.B: 하나님은 죽은 사람들의 하나님이 아니라 살아 있는 사람들의 하나님이시다. 하나님 앞에서는 모든 사람이 살아 있기 때문이다."
ko.R: 하나님은 죽은 사람들의 하나님이 아니시다. 살아 있는 사람들의 하나님이시다. 하나님 보시기에는 그 사람들이 모두 살아 있다."

pt.L: Ora, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não é Deus de mortos, mas de vivos, pois todos vivem para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}."
pt.B: Deus não é Deus de mortos, mas de vivos, pois para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} todos estão vivos."
pt.R: Deus não é o Deus de pessoas mortas. Ele é o Deus de pessoas que estão vivas. Para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, todas elas estão vivas."

am.L: እርሱም የሙታን አምላክ አይደለም፤ የሕያዋን እንጂ፤ ሁሉ ለእርሱ ሕያዋን ናቸውና።»
am.B: እግዚአብሔር የሕያዋን እንጂ የሙታን አምላክ አይደለም፤ ሁሉም ለእርሱ ሕያዋን ናቸውና።»
am.R: እግዚአብሔር የሞቱ ሰዎች አምላክ አይደለም። እርሱ በሕይወት ያሉ ሰዎች አምላክ ነው። ሁሉም በእርሱ ፊት ሕያዋን ናቸው።»

decisions.choice: not God of the dead but of the living: God's bond with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob outlasts death
alternatives: God has no concern for the dead
decisions.reason: God called himself their God long after they had died. He would not be God of people who no longer exist; they live to him, and he will raise them (13:28).

decisions.choice: all live to him: all who belong to him are alive in his sight
alternatives: all people owe their life to him
all will live for him in the future
decisions.reason: Death does not end their life toward God. A Jewish writing of the time says the same of the faithful martyrs, that they live to God (4 Maccabees 7:19; 16:25).

decisions.choice: God is not God of the dead: "God" is the predicate
alternatives: the God is not of the dead
decisions.reason: The noun without the article is what is said of him: he is not the God of the dead.

decisions.choice: Now he is not God of [the] dead
decisions.reason: Literal follows the Greek sentence, where "God" is what is said of the subject (m3); Balanced and Readable name God at the start.

decisions.choice: the quotation that opened at 20:34 closes here
decisions.reason: Jesus' answer ends here.

decisions.choice: "그분께는" (L); "하나님 앞에서는" (B); "하나님 보시기에는" (R) for "to him"
decisions.reason: All who belong to him are alive in his sight (meaning decision).

source.text: ἀποκριθέντες δέ τινες τῶν γραμματέων εἶπαν· Διδάσκαλε, καλῶς εἶπας·

records.literal_gloss: Answering then some of the scribes said, Teacher, well you said;

en.L: And some of the scribes answered and said, "Teacher, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken well."
en.B: Some of the scribes responded, "Teacher, that was a fine answer."
en.R: Some of the teachers of the law said, "Teacher, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave a good answer!"

es.L: Y respondiendo algunos de los escribas, dijeron: «Maestro, bien has dicho».
es.B: Algunos de los escribas respondieron: «Maestro, esa fue una buena respuesta».
es.R: Algunos de los maestros de la ley dijeron: «¡Maestro, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has respondido bien!».

fr.L: Et quelques-uns des scribes, prenant la parole, dirent : « Maître, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as bien parlé. »
fr.B: Quelques scribes répondirent : « Maître, c’est une belle réponse. »
fr.R: Quelques spécialistes de la Loi ont dit : « Maître, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as donné une bonne réponse ! »

sw.L: Na baadhi ya waandishi wakajibu, wakasema, "Mwalimu, umesema vema."
sw.B: Baadhi ya waandishi wakajibu, "Mwalimu, hilo ni jibu zuri."
sw.R: Baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakasema, "Mwalimu, umetoa jibu zuri!"

vi.L: Và mấy thầy thông giáo đáp lại rằng: "Thưa Thầy, Thầy đã nói hay lắm."
vi.B: Mấy thầy thông giáo lên tiếng: "Thưa Thầy, Thầy trả lời hay quá."
vi.R: Mấy thầy dạy luật nói: "Thưa Thầy, Thầy trả lời hay lắm!"

ko.L: 그러자 율법학자들 가운데 몇이 대답하여 말했다. "선생님, 잘 말씀하셨습니다."
ko.B: 율법학자 몇 사람이 말했다. "선생님, 훌륭한 대답이십니다."
ko.R: 율법을 가르치는 선생 몇 사람이 말했다. "선생님, 참 좋은 대답을 하셨습니다!"

pt.L: E alguns dos escribas responderam: "Mestre, falaste bem."
pt.B: Alguns dos escribas comentaram: "Mestre, foi uma bela resposta."
pt.R: Alguns dos mestres da Lei disseram: "Mestre, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} deste uma boa resposta!"

am.L: ከጸሐፍትም አንዳንዶቹ መልሰው «መምህር ሆይ፣ መልካም ተናገርህ።» አሉ።
am.B: ከሕግ መምህራን አንዳንዶቹ «መምህር ሆይ፣ ጥሩ መልስ ነው።» አሉ።
am.R: ከሕግ መምህራን አንዳንዶቹ «መምህር ሆይ፣ መልካም መልስ ሰጠህ!» አሉ።

decisions.choice: some of the scribes: experts in the law who believed in the resurrection
decisions.reason: Many scribes belonged to the Pharisees, who believed the dead would rise and disagreed with the Sadducees (Acts 23:6-9). They approve of Jesus' answer.

decisions.choice: the teachers of the law
decisions.reason: As in 19:47: "scribes" today suggests people who copy documents, so Readable says what these men did.

decisions.choice: The scribes speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 with "선생님" and the honorific
decisions.reason: Their praise is sincere, as in the Korean Mark 12:32.

source.text: οὐκέτι γὰρ ἐτόλμων ἐπερωτᾶν αὐτὸν οὐδέν.

records.literal_gloss: No longer for they dared to ask him anything.

en.L: For they no longer dared to ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} anything.
en.B: From then on they did not dare put any more questions to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: After this, they were afraid to ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} any more questions.

es.L: Porque ya no se atrevían a preguntarle nada.
es.B: Desde entonces no se atrevieron a hacerle más preguntas.
es.R: Después de esto, tenían miedo de hacerle más preguntas.

fr.L: Car ils n’osaient plus {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interroger sur rien.
fr.B: Dès lors, ils n’osèrent plus {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} poser aucune question.
fr.R: Après cela, ils avaient peur de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} poser d’autres questions.

sw.L: Kwa maana hawakuthubutu tena kumwuliza neno lolote.
sw.B: Tangu hapo hawakuthubutu kumwuliza maswali zaidi.
sw.R: Baada ya hapo, waliogopa kumwuliza maswali mengine.

vi.L: Vì họ không còn dám hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} điều gì nữa.
vi.B: Từ đó, họ không dám hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} điều gì nữa.
vi.R: Sau việc ấy, họ không dám hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thêm câu nào nữa.

ko.L: 그들은 더 이상 감히 그분께 아무것도 묻지 못하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 뒤로는 그들이 감히 예수께 더 묻지 못하였다.
ko.R: 그 뒤로는 아무도 예수께 더 질문할 용기를 내지 못했다.

pt.L: Pois já não ousavam perguntar-{{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} coisa alguma.
pt.B: Daí em diante, não tiveram coragem de {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} fazer mais perguntas.
pt.R: Depois disso, eles tinham medo de fazer mais perguntas a Jesus.

am.L: ከዚያ ወዲያ አንዳች ሊጠይቁት አልደፈሩምና።
am.B: ከዚያ ወዲያ ሌላ ጥያቄ ሊጠይቁት አልደፈሩም።
am.R: ከዚህ በኋላ ሌላ ጥያቄ ሊጠይቁት ፈሩ።

decisions.choice: for: the scribes' praise and the silence that follows go together
decisions.reason: Jesus' answers have ended the questioning. Luke's "for" links the scene's end with what came before.

decisions.choice: they: his questioners, all of them
decisions.reason: Chief priests, scribes, spies and Sadducees have all tried and failed (20:1-38).

source.text: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς· Πῶς λέγουσιν τὸν χριστὸν εἶναι Δαυὶδ υἱόν;

records.literal_gloss: He said then to them, How do they say the Christ to be David's son?

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "How do they say that the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} is David's son?
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "How can people say that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is the son of David?
en.R: Then Jesus asked them, "Why do people say that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is King David's descendant?

es.L: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «¿Cómo dicen que el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} es hijo de David?
es.B: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «¿Cómo puede decir la gente que el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} es hijo de David?
es.R: Luego Jesús les preguntó: «¿Por qué dice la gente que el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} es descendiente del rey David?

fr.L: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Comment dit-on que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est fils de David ?
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Comment peut-on dire que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est le fils de David ?
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus leur a demandé : « Pourquoi les gens disent-ils que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est un descendant du roi David ?

sw.L: Kisha akawaambia, "Wanasemaje kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni mwana wa Daudi?
sw.B: Kisha akawaambia, "Watu wanawezaje kusema kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni mwana wa Daudi?
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, "Kwa nini watu husema kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni mzao wa Mfalme Daudi?

vi.L: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Sao người ta nói rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} là con của Đa-vít?
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Sao người ta có thể nói rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} là con Đa-vít?
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu hỏi họ: "Tại sao người ta nói rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} là con cháu của vua Đa-vít?

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "어떻게 사람들이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}가 다윗의 자손이라고 말하느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "어떻게 사람들은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}가 다윗의 자손이라고 말할 수 있느냐?
ko.R: 그러자 예수께서 그들에게 물으셨다. "사람들은 왜 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}가 다윗 왕의 자손이라고 말하느냐?

pt.L: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Como dizem que o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} é filho de Davi?
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Como é que se diz que o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} é filho de Davi?
pt.R: Depois Jesus lhes perguntou: "Por que as pessoas dizem que o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} é descendente do rei Davi?

am.L: እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «{{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} የዳዊት ልጅ ነው እንዴት ይላሉ?
am.B: እርሱም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ሰዎች {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} የዳዊት ልጅ ነው እንዴት ሊሉ ይችላሉ?
am.R: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ እንዲህ ብሎ ጠየቃቸው፦ «ሰዎች {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} የንጉሥ ዳዊት ዘር ነው ለምን ይላሉ?

decisions.choice: the Christ: the Messiah, God's anointed king
decisions.reason: With the article it is the title of the king God promised to send (2:11, 26; 9:20).

decisions.choice: David's son: the king promised from David's line
decisions.reason: God promised David that a son of his would reign forever (2 Samuel 7:12-16; Isaiah 11:1). "Son of David" was a title for the Messiah (18:38-39), and Luke has shown that Jesus is of David's line (1:32; 2:4).

decisions.choice: they say: people in general, as the scribes taught
decisions.reason: Mark 12:35 names the scribes. Jesus speaks to those around him about what was commonly taught.

decisions.choice: How do they say: Jesus does not deny that the Christ is David's son
alternatives: Jesus rejects the Messiah's descent from David
decisions.reason: Luke has already called Jesus David's son (1:32). The question shows that the title does not say everything: the Christ is also David's Lord (20:44).

decisions.choice: King David's descendant
decisions.reason: Readable says what "son" means here (m2).

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 20:44
decisions.reason: Jesus' question runs over three sentences.

decisions.choice: el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}
decisions.reason: Here the word is a title, "the Christ", God's anointed king (meaning decision m1). Spanish keeps the article outside the span at every level, so the setting reads "el Cristo" or "el Mesías", where the English Balanced and Readable drop the article from "Christ".

decisions.choice: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} at every level
decisions.reason: The christos setting as the style guide gives it, as in Mark 12:35.

decisions.choice: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} with no honorific particle; "다윗의 자손" (L, B), "다윗 왕의 자손" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Mark 12:35.

source.text: αὐτὸς γὰρ Δαυὶδ λέγει ἐν βίβλῳ ψαλμῶν· Εἶπεν κύριος τῷ κυρίῳ μου· Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου.

records.literal_gloss: Himself for David says in book of Psalms, Said Lord to the Lord of me, Sit at right of me \v 43 until I put the enemies of you a footstool of the feet of you.

en.L: For David himself says in [the] book of Psalms, 'The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right hand \v 43 until I make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies a footstool for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet."'
en.B: David himself says in the book of Psalms, 'The Lord said to my Lord: "Take {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} seat at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right hand \v 43 until I put {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies under {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet as a footstool."'

am.L: ዳዊት ራሱ በመዝሙራት መጽሐፍ እንዲህ ይላልና፦ “ጌታ ጌታዬን እንዲህ አለው፦ ‘በቀኜ ተቀመጥ፣ \v 43 ጠላቶችህን ለእግርህ መረገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ።’”

decisions.choice: Psalm 110:1: God speaks to the one David calls his lord
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew of the psalm the first "Lord" is the divine name, YHWH, and the second is a word for lord or master, used of a king. David hears God speak to someone David himself calls lord. Peter uses the verse of Jesus' being raised to God's right hand (Acts 2:34-35).

decisions.choice: at my right hand: the place of highest honor, sharing the king's rule
alternatives: a place on one side only
decisions.reason: To sit at a king's right hand was to rule with him. Jesus will say that the Son of Man will sit at the right hand of God's power (22:69).

decisions.choice: a footstool for your feet: enemies fully defeated
decisions.reason: A conqueror might put his foot on the neck of a defeated king (Joshua 10:24).

decisions.choice: David says in the book of Psalms: the psalm is headed as David's
decisions.reason: Psalm 110 is titled "Of David", and Jesus' argument rests on David being the speaker. Luke names the book of Psalms again in Acts 1:20.

decisions.choice: the Lord God; in the place of honor; defeat your enemies and put them under your feet
alternatives: the Lord; at my right hand; make your enemies a footstool
decisions.reason: Readable shows which Lord is which (m1), what the right hand means (m2) and what the footstool pictures (m3), as at Acts 2:34-35.

decisions.choice: the psalm in single quotation marks, and God's words within it in double marks
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes David, and David quotes God, so there are three levels of speech.

decisions.choice: escabel
decisions.reason: The footstool is the picture of enemies fully defeated (meaning decision m3). "Escabel" is the plain word for a footstool; "estrado", the familiar church word, now usually means a raised platform.

decisions.choice: ‹ › for God's words inside the psalm, inside Jesus's words
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:36 and John 10:34: « » are Jesus's words, “ ” the psalm David speaks, and single guillemets ‹ › God's words within it, where the English uses single and double marks.

decisions.choice: Assieds-toi (L, R), with the deity_pronoun setting on "toi"
decisions.reason: French "s’asseoir" needs its reflexive pronoun, which the English "Sit" lacks; it refers to the Messiah, so it carries the setting like "your" in the same line, as in Mark 12:36.

decisions.choice: upande wa kulia wangu
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering of "at the right (hand)", recorded once in this file: the plain word for the right side, the place of highest honor (meaning decision m2). "Mkono wa kuume" is older and less familiar to many readers.

decisions.choice: God says "{{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}" of himself and "{{deity_pronoun:con|Con}}" to David's Lord, with the deity_pronoun span; "phán" for God speaking; "Chúa ... Chúa của tôi" with no divine-name setting
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:36: the Greek has kyrios for both; "phán" is kept for God speaking (style guide).

decisions.choice: "sách Thi Thiên"
decisions.reason: The name of the book in Vietnamese Bibles.

decisions.choice: "주님께서 내 주님께" (L, B); "주 하나님께서 내 주님께" (R), with no divine_name span; God speaks in 해라체 ("앉아 있어라")
decisions.reason: As the Korean Mark 12:36.

decisions.choice: "발판" (L, B); "발아래 굴복시키다" (R) for the footstool
decisions.reason: Enemies fully defeated (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: tu: Senta-te, Ocupa o teu lugar, os teus inimigos
decisions.reason: God speaks to David's Lord, so the psalm takes "tu" (style §4), as in Matthew 22:44 and Mark 12:36 in Portuguese; the reflexive "te" and the possessives carry the deity_pronoun setting, as the English "your" does.

decisions.choice: "ጌታ ጌታዬን እንዲህ አለው፦" (the Lord said to my Lord thus:) before God's words, which are set in ‘ ’
decisions.reason: Matthew's Amharic puts the verb of saying after God's words. Here the words run across the verse break into 20:43, so the verb comes first and the verse keeps its own content; the psalm is in “ ” inside Jesus's words and God's words in ‘ ’ inside it.

source.text: Προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν γραμματέων τῶν θελόντων περιπατεῖν ἐν στολαῖς καὶ φιλούντων ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς καὶ πρωτοκαθεδρίας ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ πρωτοκλισίας ἐν τοῖς δείπνοις, οἳ κατεσθίουσιν τὰς οἰκίας τῶν χηρῶν καὶ προφάσει μακρὰ προσεύχονται· οὗτοι λήμψονται περισσότερον κρίμα.

records.literal_gloss: Beware of the scribes, the [ones] wanting to walk in long robes and loving greetings in the marketplaces and first seats in the synagogues and first couches at the dinners, \v 47 who devour the houses of the widows and for a pretext long pray; these will receive greater condemnation.

en.L: "Beware of the scribes, who want to walk around in long robes and love greetings in the marketplaces and the first seats in the synagogues and the first couches at the banquets, \v 47 who devour the houses of widows and for a pretext pray at length; these will receive greater condemnation."
en.B: "Be on your guard against the scribes. They like to parade in long robes. They love it when people greet them in the marketplaces, and they love the front seats in the synagogues and the best couches at dinners. \v 47 They swallow up the property of widows, and they pray at great length to cover it up. These men will receive the heavier judgment."
en.R: "Be careful of the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in long, fancy robes. They love it when people greet them with honor in the markets. They love to have the most important seats in the synagogues and at big dinners. \v 47 But they cheat widows and take their homes from them. Then they say long prayers so that people will think they are good. God will punish these men more than others."

es.L: «{{plural_you:Cuídense|Cuidaos}} de los escribas, que quieren andar con túnicas largas y aman los saludos en los mercados y los primeros asientos en las sinagogas y los primeros puestos en los banquetes; \v 47 que devoran las casas de las viudas y, como pretexto, oran largamente. Estos recibirán mayor condena».
es.B: «{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado con los escribas. Les gusta pasearse con túnicas largas. Les encanta que los saluden en los mercados, y les encantan los asientos de delante en las sinagogas y los mejores puestos en los banquetes. \v 47 Se tragan los bienes de las viudas, y para disimularlo hacen largas oraciones. Estos recibirán un juicio más severo».
es.R: «{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado con los maestros de la ley. Les gusta andar con túnicas largas y elegantes. Les encanta que la gente los salude con honor en los mercados. Quieren tener los asientos más importantes en las sinagogas y en las grandes cenas. \v 47 Pero engañan a las viudas y les quitan sus casas. Luego hacen oraciones largas para que la gente piense que son buenos. Dios castigará a estos hombres más que a otros».

fr.L: « Gardez-vous des scribes, qui veulent circuler en longues robes et qui aiment les salutations sur les places publiques, les premiers sièges dans les synagogues et les premières places à table dans les banquets, \v 47 eux qui dévorent les maisons des veuves et, pour l’apparence, font de longues prières ; ceux-là recevront une condamnation plus sévère. »
fr.B: « Méfiez-vous des scribes. Ils aiment se pavaner en longues robes. Ils adorent qu’on les salue sur les places du marché, et ils aiment les premiers rangs dans les synagogues et les meilleures places à table dans les dîners. \v 47 Ils engloutissent les biens des veuves, et ils font de longues prières pour sauver les apparences. Ces gens-là recevront un jugement plus sévère. »
fr.R: « Faites attention aux spécialistes de la Loi. Ils aiment se promener avec de longues robes élégantes. Ils aiment que les gens les saluent avec respect sur les marchés. Ils aiment avoir les places les plus importantes dans les synagogues et dans les grands repas. \v 47 Mais ils trompent les veuves et leur prennent leur maison. Puis ils font de longues prières pour que les gens les croient bons. Dieu punira ces hommes plus durement que les autres. »

sw.L: "Jihadharini na waandishi, wanaotaka kutembea wakiwa na mavazi marefu, na wanaopenda salamu katika masoko, na viti vya kwanza katika masinagogi, na nafasi za kwanza katika karamu; \v 47 wanaomeza nyumba za wajane, na kwa kisingizio wanaomba kwa muda mrefu. Hawa watapokea hukumu iliyo kubwa zaidi."
sw.B: "Jihadharini na waandishi. Wanapenda kuzunguka wakiwa wamevaa majoho marefu. Wanafurahi watu wanapowasalimu sokoni, na wanapenda viti vya mbele katika masinagogi na nafasi bora katika karamu. \v 47 Wanameza mali za wajane, na ili kuficha hilo wanaomba maombi marefu. Watu hawa watapata hukumu nzito zaidi."
sw.R: "Jihadharini na walimu wa sheria. Wanapenda kutembea wakiwa wamevaa majoho marefu ya fahari. Wanapenda watu wawasalimu kwa heshima sokoni. Wanapenda kupata viti muhimu kuliko vyote katika masinagogi na kwenye karamu kubwa. \v 47 Lakini wanawadanganya wajane na kuwanyang'anya nyumba zao. Kisha wanaomba maombi marefu ili watu wadhani kwamba wao ni wema. Mungu atawaadhibu watu hawa zaidi kuliko wengine."

vi.L: "Hãy coi chừng các thầy thông giáo, là những người thích mặc áo dài đi dạo, và ưa được chào hỏi nơi chợ, và [ưa] ghế đầu trong các nhà hội và chỗ ngồi đầu trong các bữa tiệc; \v 47 là những người nuốt nhà của các bà góa, và lấy cớ mà cầu nguyện dài dòng. Những người này sẽ chịu án phạt nặng hơn."
vi.B: "Hãy đề phòng các thầy thông giáo. Họ thích mặc áo thụng dài đi khoe khoang. Họ ưa được người ta chào hỏi kính cẩn nơi phố chợ, ưa ngồi hàng ghế đầu trong các nhà hội và chỗ danh dự trong các bữa tiệc. \v 47 Họ nuốt sạch tài sản của các bà góa, rồi làm bộ cầu nguyện dài dòng. Những người này sẽ chịu bản án nặng hơn."
vi.R: "Hãy cẩn thận với các thầy dạy luật. Họ thích mặc áo dài sang trọng đi đây đi đó. Họ thích người ta chào hỏi họ cách kính trọng ở ngoài chợ. Họ thích ngồi những chỗ quan trọng nhất trong các nhà hội và trong các bữa tiệc lớn. \v 47 Nhưng họ lừa gạt các bà góa và lấy mất nhà cửa của họ. Rồi họ cầu nguyện thật dài để người ta nghĩ rằng họ là người tốt. Đức Chúa Trời sẽ phạt những người này nặng hơn những người khác."

ko.L: "율법학자들을 주의하여라. 그들은 긴 옷을 입고 다니기를 원하고, 장터에서 인사 받기와 회당에서 높은 자리와 잔치에서 윗자리를 좋아한다. \v 47 그들은 과부들의 집을 삼키고, 핑계로 길게 기도한다. 이들은 더 무거운 심판을 받을 것이다."
ko.B: "율법학자들을 조심하여라. 그들은 긴 옷을 걸치고 다니기를 좋아하고, 장터에서 사람들에게 깍듯한 인사 받기를 좋아한다. 회당에서는 높은 자리를, 잔치에서는 윗자리를 좋아한다. \v 47 그들은 과부들의 재산을 삼키면서, 남에게 보이려고 길게 기도한다. 그들은 더 무거운 벌을 받을 것이다."
ko.R: "율법을 가르치는 선생들을 조심하여라. 그들은 자기가 얼마나 높은 사람인지 보여 주는 긴 옷을 입고 다니기를 좋아한다. 사람들이 장터에서 자기에게 공손히 인사하는 것을 좋아한다. 회당에서나 큰 잔치에서나 가장 귀한 자리에 앉기를 좋아한다. \v 47 그러면서 과부들을 속여서 그들의 집까지 빼앗는다. 그리고 사람들에게 좋은 사람으로 보이려고 길게 기도한다. 하나님께서 그들을 다른 사람들보다 더 무겁게 벌하실 것이다."

pt.L: "Cuidado com os escribas, que gostam de andar com vestes longas e amam as saudações nas praças e os primeiros assentos nas sinagogas e os primeiros lugares nos banquetes, \v 47 que devoram as casas das viúvas e, por pretexto, fazem longas orações. Estes receberão condenação maior."
pt.B: "Tomem cuidado com os escribas. Eles gostam de desfilar com roupas compridas. Adoram ser cumprimentados nas praças e gostam dos primeiros assentos nas sinagogas e dos lugares de honra nos banquetes. \v 47 Eles devoram os bens das viúvas e, para disfarçar, fazem orações compridas. Esses homens receberão uma sentença mais pesada."
pt.R: "Tomem cuidado com os mestres da Lei. Eles gostam de andar com roupas compridas e elegantes. Adoram que as pessoas os cumprimentem com honra nas praças. Gostam de ter os lugares mais importantes nas sinagogas e nos grandes jantares. \v 47 Mas enganam as viúvas e tomam as casas delas. Depois fazem orações compridas para que as pessoas pensem que eles são bons. Deus vai castigar esses homens mais do que os outros."

am.L: «ረጅም ልብስ ለብሰው መመላለስ ከሚፈልጉ፣ በገበያ ቦታዎችም ሰላምታን፣ በምኩራቦችም የፊት ወንበሮችን፣ በግብዣዎችም የክብር ስፍራን ከሚወዱ ከጸሐፍት ተጠበቁ፤ \v 47 እነርሱ የመበለቶችን ቤቶች ይበላሉ፤ ለማስመሰልም ጸሎታቸውን ያስረዝማሉ፤ እነዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ።»
am.B: «ከሕግ መምህራን ተጠንቀቁ። ረጃጅም ልብስ ለብሰው መዘዋወር ይወዳሉ። በገበያ ቦታዎች ሰዎች ሰላምታ ሲያቀርቡላቸው ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ በምኩራቦች የፊት ወንበሮችን፣ በግብዣዎችም የክብር ስፍራን ይወዳሉ። \v 47 የመበለቶችን ንብረት ይውጣሉ፤ ይህን ለመሸፈንም ረጅም ጸሎት ይጸልያሉ። እነዚህ ሰዎች የከፋ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ።»
am.R: «ከሕግ መምህራን ተጠበቁ። ያማረ ረጅም ልብስ ለብሰው መዞር ይወዳሉ። በገበያ ቦታዎች ሰዎች በአክብሮት ሰላም ሲሏቸው ደስ ይላቸዋል። በምኩራቦችና በትልልቅ ግብዣዎች ላይ ከሁሉ በተከበሩት ስፍራዎች መቀመጥ ይወዳሉ። \v 47 ነገር ግን መበለቶችን ያታልላሉ፤ ቤቶቻቸውንም ይወስዱባቸዋል። ከዚያም ሰዎች ጥሩ ሰዎች እንደ ሆኑ እንዲያስቡ ረጅም ጸሎት ይጸልያሉ። እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን ሰዎች ከሌሎች ይበልጥ ይቀጣቸዋል።»

decisions.choice: long robes: the long, flowing garments of men of rank and learning
decisions.reason: The word is used for a fine robe (15:22) or a festive garment. The scribes wear theirs to be noticed.

decisions.choice: greetings, first seats, first couches: public signs of honor
decisions.reason: Respected teachers were greeted with titles in the marketplace. The front seats in a synagogue faced the people (11:43), and at a dinner the couches nearest the host were the places of honor (14:7-11), since guests reclined to eat.

decisions.choice: devour the houses of widows: take widows' property
alternatives: eat in widows' homes as guests
decisions.reason: "House" here means a household's property. The scribes may have charged for advice, managed estates for their own gain, or pressed widows to give. Luke does not say how. The law and the prophets warned against wronging widows (Exodus 22:22; Deuteronomy 24:17; Isaiah 10:2), and the next scene shows a poor widow giving all she had (21:1-4).

decisions.choice: for a pretext: for show, to hide what they are
alternatives: as an excuse for being late
decisions.reason: The word means an outward show put on to cover the real purpose (Philippians 1:18).

decisions.choice: greater condemnation: a heavier sentence from God
decisions.reason: Those who know more and use religion to cover wrong will be judged more strictly (12:47-48).

decisions.choice: the teachers of the law
decisions.reason: As in 19:47: "scribes" today suggests people who copy documents, so Readable says what these men did.

decisions.choice: so that people will think they are good; God will punish
alternatives: for a pretext; these will receive condemnation
decisions.reason: Readable says what the pretext is for (m4) and who condemns them (m5).

decisions.choice: the best couches (B); the first couches (L)
decisions.reason: People reclined on couches at a formal meal (m2), so Balanced keeps the couch.

decisions.choice: devoran las casas (L); se tragan los bienes (B)
decisions.reason: "Devour the houses of widows" means consuming their property (meaning decision m3, uncertain). Literal keeps the picture; Balanced says "bienes", as the English Balanced says "property", and keeps a verb of swallowing.

decisions.choice: les premières places à table (L); les meilleures places à table (B)
decisions.reason: Guests reclined on couches at a formal meal (m2). French "lit" or "divan" would make readers picture a bedroom or a sofa, so French names the place at table, which keeps the sense of honour; the English Balanced keeps "couches".

decisions.choice: wanaomeza nyumba (L); wanameza mali (B)
decisions.reason: "Devour the houses of widows" means consuming their property (meaning decision m3, uncertain). Literal keeps the picture with "kumeza" (to swallow); Balanced says "mali" (property), as the English Balanced does, and keeps the same verb.

decisions.choice: "Hãy coi chừng" (L); "Hãy đề phòng" (B); "Hãy cẩn thận" (R)
decisions.reason: The three forms used for warnings in the Vietnamese Mark 12:38 and 13:5.

decisions.choice: "nuốt nhà của các bà góa" (L); "nuốt sạch tài sản" (B); "lừa gạt ... lấy mất nhà cửa" (R); "nhà hội" for synagogue
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:40.

decisions.choice: The wording of the Korean Mark 12:38-40; "주의하여라" (L), "조심하여라" (B, R); "심판" (L), "벌" (B, R) for krima
decisions.reason: Luke's warning matches Mark's closely.

decisions.choice: "율법학자들" (L, B); "율법을 가르치는 선생들" (R)
decisions.reason: As through Luke 19-20.

decisions.choice: os primeiros lugares (L); os lugares de honra (B)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced keeps the couches on which guests reclined (m2). Portuguese "divã" or "leito" at a dinner would puzzle readers, so Literal and Balanced speak of the places, as Mark 12:39 does in Portuguese; the meaning note keeps the custom.

decisions.choice: "ቤቶችን ይበላሉ" (they devour the houses, L); "ንብረት ይውጣሉ" (swallow up the property, B); "ቤቶቻቸውን ይወስዱባቸዋል" (take their homes, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means, taking widows' property, as the English does.
